metadata.description: Lelik's agents_registry (VOICE_COMPANION_RFC §4.15): the specialists he reaches with delegate_to_specialist — search_memory, search_web_light (fast single lookup), and Alek as ask_alek (question, waited for) or tell_alek (errand, background, outcome to chat) — with the question/errand boundary, the late-answer and attribution rules, and 'nothing reaches chat unless given to Alek'.
